description: THE EXPLICIT-REFUSAL CASE. One harness that really does assert four things, but makes every call through a VALUE - the helper is passed into a driver function and pulled out of an object by a computed key. Neither route can be followed on source text, so the callsite count is an undercount of unknown size and the harness is REFUSED by name with CORROBORATION_HELPER_ESCAPES_AS_VALUE. Counting what can be seen and calling it corroborated would present an unscanned harness as clean, which is the dangerous direction.
